title.original: ModTrans: Translating Real-world Models for Distributed Training Simulator
title.zh: ModTrans：为分布式训练模拟器转换真实模型
title.en: ModTrans: Translating Real-world Models for Distributed Training Simulator

inclusion_reason.zh: ModTrans 将真实模型自动转换为 ASTRA-sim 输入，作为连接模型开发与分布式训练仿真的可复用适配层。
inclusion_reason.en: ModTrans automatically converts real models into ASTRA-sim inputs, serving as a reusable adapter between model development and distributed-training simulation.

abstract.zh: ModTrans 把真实机器学习模型自动转换为 ASTRA-sim 可接收的表示，使研究者无需手工重写模型即可仿真分布式训练通信。
abstract.en: ModTrans automatically translates real machine-learning models into ASTRA-sim inputs, allowing distributed-training simulation without manually recreating model descriptions.

problem.zh: 分布式训练实验需要昂贵硬件，仿真器虽可替代实机，却因输入格式与实际开发模型脱节而形成使用门槛。
problem.en: Distributed-training experiments require expensive hardware, yet simulators remain difficult to use because their input formats are disconnected from models built in normal ML workflows.

approach.zh: 工具解析真实模型的结构与相关执行信息，映射到 ASTRA-sim 所需的模型格式，并检验转换开销和仿真可用性。
approach.en: The tool parses a real model's structure and relevant execution information, maps them into ASTRA-sim's model format, and evaluates translation overhead and simulator usability.

system_design.zh: 前端接收开发框架中的模型，规范化层提取算子和通信关系，后端生成 ASTRA-sim 输入文件，从而连接模型开发与系统仿真流程。
system_design.en: A frontend ingests models from development frameworks, a normalization layer extracts operators and communication relationships, and a backend emits ASTRA-sim input files linking model development to systems simulation.

key_results.zh: 论文报告转换成本相对仿真实验可以忽略，说明该桥接层不会成为主要性能负担。
key_results.en: The paper reports negligible translation cost relative to the simulation workflow, indicating that the bridge does not become a material performance burden.

limitations.zh: 转换正确性受前端支持的算子和动态控制流限制；仿真结果仍继承 ASTRA-sim 的硬件与网络模型误差。
limitations.en: Correctness is limited by supported operators and dynamic control flow, while resulting experiments still inherit ASTRA-sim's hardware and network modeling errors.

notes.zh: 已填模型、工作负载、硬件与基线均来自官方 arXiv 摘要或 comment；摘要未给出可安全转录的结果数字，表格明细与部署配置仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Populated models, workloads, hardware, and baselines come from the official arXiv abstract or comment; the abstract provides no result number safe to transcribe, and table details plus deployment configuration still require full-text audit.
